description: The roots question on RetroDECK and EmuDeck: each root's path, whether the settings that decide it held the value (read), the frontend's own default applies (frontend-default), or atlas fell back on the arrangement's layout (assumed), the setting that decides it, and the code where no path can be stated.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-read-from-the-marker-and-romdirectory
vectors.rationale: Every root is set: the marker's three paths and ES-DE's ROMDirectory each hold the value, so every entry is read and names the setting it came from.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-assume-an-unset-saves-path-under-the-read-home
vectors.rationale: saves_path is unset beside a read rd_home_path: the saves root falls back under the home that was read, and is assumed — the setting that would move it is still named.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-assume-a-saves-path-written-empty
vectors.rationale: saves_path is present and empty: an empty string names no folder, so the saves root falls back under the read home and is assumed, the same as a key that is not written at all.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-assume-an-unset-bios-path-under-the-read-home
vectors.rationale: bios_path is unset beside a read rd_home_path: the BIOS folder falls back under that home and is assumed.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-assume-an-unset-home-and-read-the-rest
vectors.rationale: rd_home_path is unset while bios_path and saves_path are set: the installation root is assumed at <home>/retrodeck, and the two set sub-roots stay read.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-assume-every-root-of-a-marker-without-paths
vectors.rationale: A marker that parses and has no paths section: the three marker roots are assumed under <home>/retrodeck, and nothing about the marker is a finding.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-assume-every-root-of-a-marker-with-a-malformed-path
vectors.rationale: paths.saves_path is not a string, so the marker is invalid and every marker root falls back: all three are assumed, and marker-invalid rides the answer.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-read-the-paths-of-a-marker-with-an-invalid-version
vectors.rationale: A version that is not a string costs the version comparison and nothing else: the paths are kept and read, and marker-invalid with key version rides the answer.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-assume-every-root-of-an-unreadable-marker
vectors.rationale: The marker exists and cannot be read: the three marker roots are assumed, and marker-unreadable rides the answer.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-take-the-frontend-default-for-an-unset-romdirectory
vectors.rationale: ES-DE's settings set no ROMDirectory: the frontend falls back on <its home>/ROMs, and the ROM entry says frontend-default rather than read.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-take-the-frontend-default-without-es-de-settings
vectors.rationale: No es_settings.xml at all is a reading too: no value is configured, so the frontend's own default applies and the entry still names the setting that would move it.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-read-a-romdirectory-after-the-tilde-expansion
vectors.rationale: A ROMDirectory written with ~ is expanded against the frontend's own home, as ES-DE expands it, and is read.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-state-no-rom-root-for-a-relative-romdirectory
vectors.rationale: A ROMDirectory that is not absolute after the frontend's ~ expansion names no root: the ROM entry has no path and states roms-root-not-absolute, the code health states.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-state-no-rom-root-for-unreadable-es-de-settings
vectors.rationale: ES-DE's settings exist and cannot be read: the ROM entry has no path and states config-unreadable about that file, the code health states.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-carry-the-saves-finding-and-leave-the-rom-finding-to-health
vectors.rationale: The saves root and the configured ROM root are both not there: saves-root-missing rides the roots answer like every answer, while roms-root-missing stays on health alone.

vectors.name: retrodeck-roots-of-an-installation-not-set-up
vectors.rationale: RetroDECK is deployed and has never written its marker: the marker roots are assumed at the layout setup chooses, each naming the key it would write, and the ROM root has no path and states not-set-up.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-read-from-settings-sh-and-romdirectory
vectors.rationale: Every root is set: settings.sh names romsPath, biosPath and savesPath, ES-DE names ROMDirectory, so every entry is read; the installation root is the parent of romsPath and names that key.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-assume-the-installation-root-of-an-unset-romspath
vectors.rationale: romsPath is unset: the installation root is the parent of EmuDeck's default ~/Emulation/roms and is assumed, still naming romsPath as the setting that decides it.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-assume-a-saves-path-written-empty
vectors.rationale: savesPath is written with an empty value: it names no folder, so the saves root falls back under ~/Emulation and is assumed, the same as a key that is not written at all.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-assume-unset-bios-and-saves-paths
vectors.rationale: biosPath and savesPath are unset: both fall back under ~/Emulation, EmuDeck's default, and are assumed.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-assume-every-root-of-unreadable-settings
vectors.rationale: settings.sh exists and cannot be read: the three settings.sh roots are assumed under ~/Emulation, and marker-unreadable rides the answer.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-take-the-frontend-default-for-an-unset-romdirectory
vectors.rationale: ES-DE is on this EmuDeck and sets no ROMDirectory: the frontend falls back on ~/ROMs, and the ROM entry says frontend-default.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-state-no-rom-root-without-es-de
vectors.rationale: No ES-DE is on this EmuDeck: no setting decides a frontend ROM root, so the entry names none, has no path, and states emulator-catalogue-unestablished — health states nothing for this, so the code is the one the ROM question states.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-carry-the-frontend-marker-mismatch-without-es-de
vectors.rationale: settings.sh records doInstallESDE=true while no ES-DE is on disk: the ROM entry states emulator-catalogue-unestablished, and frontend-marker-mismatch rides the answer, as it rides rom_location().

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-resolve-an-unset-romdirectory-beside-a-portable-txt
vectors.rationale: A portable.txt sits beside the AppImage and ROMDirectory is unset. The file moves nothing — an AppImage ES-DE looks for portable.txt in getExePath() (main.cpp:148-149 at v3.4.1), the directory of the canonical /proc/self/exe (FileSystemUtil.cpp:383-404) — inside the image's own mount, never the folder the image file sits in — so the frontend's default resolves against the user's home: the ROM entry is ~/ROMs with provenance frontend-default, and no caveat rides the answer. That directory is not on this machine, which health states as roms-root-missing.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-read-an-absolute-romdirectory-beside-a-portable-txt
vectors.rationale: A portable.txt is there and ROMDirectory is absolute: the value is read, as roms_dir() and health() answer it, and nothing rides the answer about the file, because an AppImage ES-DE looks for portable.txt in getExePath() (main.cpp:148-149 at v3.4.1), the directory of the canonical /proc/self/exe (FileSystemUtil.cpp:383-404) — inside the image's own mount, never the folder the image file sits in.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-state-no-rom-root-for-a-relative-romdirectory
vectors.rationale: ROMDirectory is relative even after the frontend's ~ expansion: the ROM entry has no path and states roms-root-not-absolute.

vectors.name: emudeck-roots-state-no-rom-root-for-unreadable-es-de-settings
vectors.rationale: ES-DE's settings exist and cannot be read: the ROM entry has no path and states config-unreadable about that file.
